A store owner recorded the number of units of a certain product that were sold per day for 36 days. What is the minimum number of units this product sold per day for these 36 days?

The function T estimates the temperature, in degrees Fahrenheit (F), in a certain city one day in January, where x is the number of hours after 10 a.m. and 1 <= x <= 7. Which statement is the best interpretation of T(5) = 21 in this context?

options.A: 5 hours after 10 a.m., the function estimates that the temperature is 21 F.
options.B: 5 hours before 10 a.m., the function estimates that the temperature decreased 21 F.
options.C: 5 hours after 10 a.m., the function estimates that the temperature decreased 21 F.
options.D: 5 hours before 10 a.m., the function estimates that the temperature is 21 F.

text: The graph of the function f in the xy-plane, where y = f(x), has x-intercepts of (-5, 0), (3, 0), and (6, 0). Which of the following must be true?
If f(x) = x + 2 and g(x) = 2x, what is the value of 3f(-5) - g(-5)?

A botanist wants to plant certain types of oak trees and pine trees in a 600-foot-long row. Each of these oak trees requires 40 feet of space to grow, and each of these pine trees requires 30 feet of space to grow. The equation 40x + 30y = 600 models the possible number of oak trees, x, and pine trees, y, that the botanist can plant. Which graph represents this relationship?

options.C: Graph of a line with a positive slope

text: The number of bacteria in a liquid medium doubles every day. There are 72,000 bacteria in the liquid medium at the start of an observation. Which of the following represents the number of bacteria, y, in the liquid medium t days after the start of the observation?

For a certain isotope, at the end of every 29-year period, the mass of a sample of the isotope has decayed to half its mass at the beginning of the 29-year period. The function s(t) = 216(0.5)^{t/29} gives the approximate mass of this isotope, in grams, that remains t years after a 216-gram sample starts to decay. Which statement is the best interpretation of s(3 * 29) = 27 in this context?

options.A: The mass of the sample is approximately 27 grams t years after the sample starts to decay.
options.B: The mass of the sample is approximately 27 grams 3 29-year periods after the sample starts to decay.
options.C: The mass of the sample is approximately t grams 3 29-year periods after the sample starts to decay.
options.D: The mass of the sample is approximately t grams 27 years after the sample starts to decay.
